message: Los comerciantes de esta cuadra de Kennedy pusieron tablas para apartar la mercancía del agua. Uno quisiera seguir trabajando normal, pero la calzada sigue inundada. #Bogota #inundacion

attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0014: Handheld phone photograph at the frontage of a small neighborhood hardware and household goods shop in Kennedy, Bogotá. Plain cardboard merchandise boxes and unbranded sacks resting on wooden planks lifted above damp ground, a cropped merchant's hands adjusting them. Outside the shuttered opening, the street is still covered with shallow muddy water. Focus on improvised raised shelves and supplies; grey metal shutter at left, no legible signage.
